title: Single pullback comparison respects composition of two morphisms
statement: Choose shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be arbitrary scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and let $N$ be an $\mathcal O_Z$-module [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $p_b$ for canonicalSinglePullbackMap [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison], and $c_{f,g}$ for the chosen derived composition isomorphism [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], pinned by its leftDerivedLift factorization. With $E=N[0]$ and $P_{f,g}=\operatorname{pullbackComp}(f,g)$ [def-pc-module-pullback], the following equality of morphisms into $((f\gg g)^*N)[0]$ holds: $c_{f,g}(E).\mathrm{hom}\gg p_{f\gg g}(N)=Lf^*(p_g(N))\gg p_f(g^*N)\gg(P_{f,g}(N).\mathrm{hom})[0]$. No flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0D5S; defining leftDerivedLift factorization in exists_derivedPullbackComposition and Mathlib Functor.leftDerived_fac_app

proof.text: Evaluate Functor.leftDerived_fac_app at the homotopy single complex of N, using the chosen composition hom equation and the chosen IsLeftDerivedFunctor witness. This identifies c(f,g).hom followed by ε_(f≫g) with Lf*(ε_g), then ε_f at the termwise g-pullback, then the mapped tensor composition mate. Postcompose by the single-complex comparison for f≫g and the single embedding of the unique tensor-to-ordinary left-adjoint isomorphism.

Apply homotopySinglePullbackComposition to identify c ≫ r_(f≫g) with T_f(r_g) ≫ r_f ≫ single(pullbackComp.hom). Apply naturality of the chosen derived counit ε_f to r_g. Postcompose the evaluated leftDerived_fac_app equation with Qh(r_(f≫g)), substitute the homotopy composition identity, and use that naturality equation to obtain the two successive derived single comparisons. Unfold canonicalSinglePullbackMap and combine functor maps and associativity.

theorem canonicalSinglePullbackComposition
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (N : Z.Modules) :
    ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) f g).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj N) ≫
      canonicalSinglePullbackMap (f ≫ g) N =
    (derivedPullback f).map (canonicalSinglePullbackMap g N) ≫
      canonicalSinglePullbackMap f ((pullback g).obj N) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
          ((pullbackComp f g).hom.app N)
